The crew will study human health in deep space and photograph the moon from close range, testing whether such journeys can be practical for future moon landings. Artemis is a US-led programme with international contributions from Europe, Japan, Canada and the UAE. The mission aims to pave the way for a lunar base and further deep-space exploration, as China also pursues crewed moon landings. Al Jazeera's Colin Baker reports.
